title: Program fields of DR-0003
description: DR-0003 (ROUNDS-01-L03) passes docs/decisions/decision-record.schema.json like every record, and its program fields pass this schema too: the 20 gate strings (rounds-review src/data/capabilities.ts:185-209), the gate artifact table with one producer per row (decision P6), and the ROUNDS-01 closure condition (decision P7). A row names its producer as a leaf or stage ID, or, for a per-row artifact, as producerFrom: the DR-0002 matrix field that names each row's producer. Exactly one of the two is set; scripts/program/lib.mjs checks that and resolves every reference.

producer.description: The one leaf or stage that produces the artifact, or null when producerFrom names a per-row producer.

producerFrom.description: For a per-row artifact: the DR-0002 matrix field whose value is each row's one producer. Rows whose field holds no leaf (n/a or blocked cells, no transfer) have no such artifact.

designation.description: Only on the reference leaf row: default (taken under the owner's delegation) or owner-designated.

requiredFor.description: Leaves that consume this artifact whatever their archetype or domain (the forced bindings of decision P6).

paths.description: Where the artifact lives on next when this revision was written; empty until its producer lands.
